description: Reg. § 1.199A-3(b)(1)(iv): an allowed loss of a QBI-flagged passive activity reduces QBI. Wages $100,000, nonpassive K-1 income $30,000, actively managed rental (a qualified trade or business) with a $10,000 loss, all allowed (modified AGI $130,000 → line 8 $10,000): QBI 30,000 − 10,000 = $20,000 → $4,000.
